create.name: Shivam Rath
create.bio:
Shivam Rath is an Australian musician and Nāda Yoga teacher based in Byron Bay, New South Wales, whose teaching grows out of nearly two decades of study in Hindustani classical music. He plays the 22-string Indian slide guitar, or chaturangi, and is known for sliding along its strings with a Himalayan crystal sphere, a habit that began in Dharamsala in 2013 after he lost his usual steel bar. He trained with the slide guitarist Debashish Bhattacharya, also plays tabla and shakuhachi, and composes and produces under his Crystal Slide name and with the world-music group Boom Shanko.

For Shivam, raga is a way of training attention as much as a set of scales: students learn to listen closely, sing and play with feeling, and settle into a meditative flow. He leads small-group Raga Retreats that weave together raga, mantra, voice, rhythm, yoga and time in nature, held in the Northern Rivers hinterland, in Dharamshala and Varanasi in India, and in the tea country of Yunnan and Fujian in China. He also gives private lessons and mentoring in raga, voice, rhythm and slide guitar, online or in person in northern New South Wales, and shares guided Nāda Nidra and yoga nidra sessions alongside his music.

courses.title: Raga Retreat Australia 2027
courses.description: A five-night residential retreat in the Northern Rivers hinterland behind Byron Bay, combining raga, mantra, voice, rhythm, yoga, meditation and time in nature. Accommodation ranges from off-grid camping to private rainforest studios, and the venue is confirmed as bookings come in.

courses.title: Raga Retreat Resolution: Himalayan Nāda Yoga Retreat, India
courses.description: An all-inclusive week near Dharamshala in the days after Mahashivaratri, with daily raga, mantra, yoga and sound sessions in a private mountain retreat. An optional musical pilgrimage through Kolkata and Varanasi comes beforehand.
courses.price: $2,000 AUD (standard rate from 1 Nov 2026; $500 AUD deposit)

courses.title: China Raga Journeys 2027 (Yunnan and Fujian)
courses.description: Two linked small-group retreats that pair raga training with Chinese tea culture: a five-night immersion in Lijiang, Yunnan, then a music, yoga and tea retreat in the Wuyishan mountains of Fujian. Either can be joined alone, or both at a combined rate.

courses.title: Private lessons and mentoring
courses.description: One-to-one sessions in raga, voice, rhythm, improvisation and the Indian slide guitar, shaped around each student's level and interests. Lessons run online anywhere, or in person in northern New South Wales, with a block of at least four.

free_resources.title: Shivam Rath on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Guided Nāda Nidra and yoga nidra sessions, mantra chants, kirtan and raga recordings, plus occasional live sessions. Free to listen to.

free_resources.title: Crystal Slide video lessons
free_resources.description: A free set of four video lessons on the Indian slide guitar, from tuning and a first taste of an alap to the scale of a single raga and basic movement along the fretboard.
